scope: Evaluate exactly the single primary contrast registered in research/m2-type-i-holdout-prereg-v1.json. No alternate threshold, endpoint or subgroup can become a replacement primary test.
closeout: The one-time Holdout has been consumed. Future CI may verify the frozen result but must not recompute or reopen this Holdout for iterative tuning.
